question: Which individual heads and MLPs are required for the all-band cue-source graph to write the eight weight-derived response coordinates?
intervention: For each of all 110 heads/modules in layers 0-10, base-clamp only that component while the cue embedding drives every other component; compare the resulting eight compiled coordinates and native donor behavior with the all-component source graph.
ranking: For each fit and component, coordinate impairment is max(0, 1 - minimum signed coordinate projection); native impairment is max(0, 1 - minimum task signed projection). Rank by the maximum of coordinate and native impairment across fits, then site name.
candidate_pool: Union the frozen atlas top20 with the shortest ranked prefix containing at least 90% of total positive deletion score; this is frozen for the subsequent greedy construction run.

predictions.pred_a_authority_all_source_equivalence_: authorities replay, unrestricted cue-source execution matches the donor trajectory, all values are finite, and <=128 forwards execute
predictions.pred_b_individual_dependencies_are_detec: at least one component deletion causes >=0.05 coordinate or native impairment under both fits
predictions.pred_c_dependency_importance_is_concentr: a prefix of <=30 components contains >=80% of total positive deletion score
predictions.pred_d_dependencies_extend_beyond_the_do: at least one of the ten highest deletion-score components is outside the frozen donor-patch top20
predictions.pred_e_weight_coordinate_edges_are_cross: even/odd component deletion rankings have Spearman correlation >=0.75 and top-20 overlap >=15

decision: Use the frozen candidate pool for a source-driven greedy construction. The component-to-most-impaired-coordinate map is the upstream-to-weight-reader edge atlas; a diffuse null triggers interaction-aware grouped deletion rather than DAS refitting.
